description: The boat test with no cargo: drifting, sailing, turning, walking on deck, saving and loading. With -Ablate it also runs with the water surface not drawn (the waves and floating keep going), with only the water's coarse pieces (water_mesh: triangles against pixels), and with no shadows on the water (water_shadows), to show what drawing the water costs. With -Preset low, water_low_far and water_low_shadows put back what the low preset saves on the water (07 'The water's cost'): the frame gets slower by that saving.
